title: C# library component diagram
description: The C# library: one solution with the library project, two test projects and the engine-interface sketch. The library embeds the repository's schema; the tests read the schema and conformance material in place.

components.name: C# library
components.responsibility: The solution Utv.sln and the library's README and CHANGELOG.

components.name: Utv library
components.responsibility: The package: validation, the JSON layer, the text form, zone rules, interop and the typed layer.

components.name: Library tests
components.responsibility: xUnit tests of the shared fixtures, structural examples, schema, results, JSON layer, interop and typed layer.

components.name: Example tests
components.responsibility: The examples as unit tests: UTV first and native first.

components.name: Engine-interface sketch
components.responsibility: The C# interface sketch of the planned engine.

components.name: Structural schema
components.responsibility: schema/utv-1.0.schema.json, embedded into the library at build time and compared with the embedded copy by the tests.

components.name: Conformance material
components.responsibility: Structural examples, the everyday and text-form fixtures, and the demo zone rules, read in place by the tests.

components.name: .NET 8 base class library
components.responsibility: System.Text.Json, System.Numerics, System.Text.RegularExpressions, and DateOnly, TimeOnly, DateTime, DateTimeOffset, TimeSpan, TimeZoneInfo and System.Globalization for interop and the native-first examples. The library's only runtime dependency.

components.name: xUnit and the .NET test SDK
components.responsibility: xunit 2.9.3, xunit.runner.visualstudio 2.8.2 and Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 17.12.0, referenced by both test projects only.

relationships.description: Embedded resource Utv.utv-1.0.schema.json, linked from the repository file.
SchemaTests compares the embedded copy with the repository file.
Reads examples/*.json, operations/everyday.json, operations/text-form.json and the rule bundles they name, from the repository root.
Links conformance/rules/demo-zones.json next to the test assembly; Fixtures.DemoZoneRules loads it.
The native-first suite exercises .NET's own date and time API, which reads the host's tz database and clock.
